# Charlie Sloane

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P29](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is characterized by his prominent, goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors a long-standing infatuation with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). He is motivated by ambitious political aspirations, intending to enter politics and serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Goals

- go into politics and be a member of Parliament  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Prior to his later school years, Charlie Sloane once dared Arty Gillis to jump over an old well and also got into a fight with [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), licking him because [Moody Spurgeon](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md) had accused [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) of putting on airs. Harboring an admiration for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Charlie once confessed to his mother that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was the smartest girl in school. Additionally, Charlie was known to indulge in literary flights of imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)_

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Charlie is considered a presumed rival of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for the affection of a gray-eyed girl. However, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is also seen alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), sharing moments such as finding solace together when an old house burns down during a severe hail storm.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +2 more_
